Game Overview

Fruit Mania is a puzzle game built around join Wagoo, the hungry lemming, in a fast-paced fruit feast. Click matching fruits quickly to satisfy Wagoo’s cravings in under 60 seconds. Simple yet addictive, this vibrant puzzle game offers endless fun for all ages. Can you beat the clock and set a fruity high score?
